name: awt
description: Full-stack educational clone of the Kerala government scholarship portal [https://egrantz.kerala.gov.in/](https://egrantz.kerala.gov.in/), built for the Advanced Web Technologies course. This MERN stack version evolved from the pure HTML/CSS/JS first evaluation.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
